WITH refunded_cdemo AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'S', 'U')
    AND cd_education_status IN ('Primary', 'College', 'Advanced Degree')
), returning_cdemo AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status = refunded_cdemo.cd_marital_status
    AND cd_education_status = refunded_cdemo.cd_education_status
), state_filter AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
), profit_filter AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_net_profit
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN state_filter ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = state_filter.ca_address_sk
  WHERE state_filter.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA')
    AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_net_profit
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN state_filter ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = state_filter.ca_address_sk
  WHERE state_filter.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA')
    AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_net_profit
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN state_filter ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = state_filter.ca_address_sk
  WHERE state_filter.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY')
    AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
), web_returns_data AS (
  SELECT wr_item_sk, AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash, AVG(wr_fee) AS avg_fee
  FROM web_returns
  JOIN profit_filter ON web_returns.ws_item_sk = profit_filter.ws_item_sk
  GROUP BY wr_item_sk
), web_sales_data AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN profit_filter ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = profit_filter.ws_item_sk
  GROUP BY ws_item_sk
), reason_data AS (
  SELECT r_reason_desc, AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash, AVG(wr_fee) AS avg_fee
  FROM web_returns
  JOIN profit_filter ON web_returns.ws_item_sk = profit_filter.ws_item_sk
  JOIN reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = web_returns.wr_reason_sk
  WHERE date_dim.d_year = 1998
  AND web_returns.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk IN (refunded_cdemo.cd_demo_sk, returning_cdemo.cd_demo_sk)
  GROUP BY r_reason_desc
), result AS (
  SELECT SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20) AS reason_short, avg_quantity, avg_refunded_cash, avg_fee
  FROM web_sales_data
  JOIN reason_data ON web_sales_data.ws_item_sk = reason_data.wr_item_sk
)
SELECT reason_short, AVG(avg_quantity) OVER(), AVG(avg_refunded_cash) OVER(), AVG(avg_fee) OVER()
FROM result
ORDER BY reason_short, AVG(avg_quantity), AVG(avg_refunded_cash), AVG(avg_fee)
LIMIT 100

  FROM web_returns
  JOIN profit_filter ON web_returns.ws_item_sk = profit_filter.ws_item_sk
  JOIN reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = web_returns.wr_reason_sk
  WHERE date_dim.d_year = 1998
  AND web_returns.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk IN (refunded_cdemo.cd_demo_sk, returning_cdemo.cd_demo_sk)
), web_sales_data AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN profit_filter ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = profit_filter.ws_item_sk
), result AS (
  SELECT SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20) AS reason_short, avg_quantity, avg_refunded_cash, avg_fee
  FROM web_sales_data
  JOIN reason_data ON web_sales_data.ws_item_sk = reason_data.wr_item_sk
)
SELECT reason_short, AVG(avg_quantity) OVER(), AVG(avg_refunded_cash) OVER(), AVG(avg_fee) OVER()
FROM result
JOIN state_filter ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = state_filter.ca_address_sk
WHERE state_filter.ca_state IN (
  SELECT ca_state
  FROM state_filter
  WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
) AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN (
  SELECT MIN(min_profit)
  FROM (
    SELECT 'NC', 'TX', 'IA' AS states, MIN(ws_net_profit) AS min_profit
    FROM profit_filter
    WHERE ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'WI', 'WV', 'GA' AS states, MIN(ws_net_profit) AS min_profit
    FROM profit_filter
    WHERE ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'OK', 'VA', 'KY' AS states, MIN(ws_net_profit) AS min_profit

GROUP BY reason_short
ORDER BY reason_short, AVG(avg_quantity), AVG(avg_refunded_cash), AVG(avg_fee)

This version reduces the number of subqueries and joins by combining the state filtering into a single query and using a subquery to find the minimum profit for each group of states. This should result in fewer repeated scans of the same tables and potentially faster execution times.
